scope: Military soldier grab eligibility and layered-rig corpse/dismemberment regression
status: Code and static review only; user deferred build and runtime tests.

evidence.issue: Heavy Blackwatch cannot be grabbed at full health
evidence.cause: ConsumeSystem.healthReady used original maximum health < 50 as direct-grab tier. Blackwatch heavy is authored at 60, regular army heavy at 48. Both grab and consume confirmation use this gate.
evidence.change: Uninfected MilitarySoldier keeps ordinary-human grab class regardless of health. Other eligibility, ownership, line-of-sight, ground and boss execution gates remain in effect.

evidence.issue: Layered soldier stays whole after an accepted sharp killing strike
evidence.cause: Independent rigid body per uniform/equipment/gun mesh fills the 48-part ceiling before the first cut. applyCut/cutAt reject cuts at that same ceiling. Heavy Blackwatch has at least 50 clothing/equipment declarations before split sleeves and gun geometry.
evidence.change: Map soldier skins onto 13 authored motion joints before rigid body construction. Keep 48 intact bones for generic models and a separate bounded 16-fragment reserve (64 total); vertex and initial scene limits are unchanged.

evidence.issue: Incorrect collider and mass after the existing generic over-budget merge
evidence.cause: Appending tiny.mesh into owner.mesh left final center/half/invMass calculated for the old skin.
evidence.change: Rebuild the merged Part before initial momentum/joints are created; preserve root identity and all merged skin.
evidence.limit: This removes a concrete collision/constraint mismatch that can contribute to corpse hopping. Repeated hopping on normal terrain and steps has NOT been runtime-verified as resolved.
